q: 弟弟跑___很快，同学们都比不上他。
zh: 弟弟跑得很快，同学们都比不上他。
py: dì di pǎo de hěn kuài tóng xué men dōu bǐ bù shàng tā
en: My brother runs very fast; none of his classmates can match him.
why: 很 describes how he runs, so the degree complement 得 links verb and adjective. 不 would form a potential 跑不快, which cannot take 很.

q: 这么多水果，我们一家三口一个星期也吃___了。
zh: 这么多水果，我们一家三口一个星期也吃不了。
py: zhè me duō shuǐ guǒ wǒ men yī jiā sān kǒu yī ge xīng qī yě chī bù liǎo
en: With this much fruit, the three of us can't finish it even in a week.
why: Too much to get through, with no result word: 吃不了 (liǎo). 也 ('even in a week') signals failure, so 吃得了 is out.

s: 门这么小，大沙发怎么搬得进去？
s_py: mén zhè me xiǎo dà shā fā zěn me bān de jìn qù
zh: 门这么小，大沙发怎么搬得进去？
py: mén zhè me xiǎo dà shā fā zěn me bān de jìn qù
en: The door is so small; how can the big sofa possibly get in?
why: A positive potential 搬得进去 is natural in a rhetorical 怎么 question meaning 'how could it be carried in'.

s: 这些菜你们吃得完不完？
s_py: zhè xiē cài nǐ men chī de wán bù wán
zh: 这些菜你们吃得完吃不完？
py: zhè xiē cài nǐ men chī de wán chī bù wán
en: Can you finish all these dishes or not?
why: The pair repeats the whole form (吃得完吃不完). Doubling only the complement, 吃得完不完, is not allowed.

src_py: zhè jiàn yī fu nǐ mǎi de qǐ
task: Ask 'can you afford it or not?' with both forms side by side.
zh: 这件衣服你买得起买不起？
py: zhè jiàn yī fu nǐ mǎi de qǐ mǎi bù qǐ
en: Can you afford this piece of clothing or not?
why: The full pair 买得起买不起 is the alternative question and takes no 吗. Doubling only the complement (买得起不起) is not allowed.

s: 他的电话号码，我想起不来了。
s_py: tā de diàn huà hào mǎ wǒ xiǎng qǐ bù lái le
zh: 他的电话号码，我想不起来了。
py: tā de diàn huà hào mǎ wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái le
en: I can't remember his phone number any more.
why: 不 goes right after 想, before the whole direction word 起来. It cannot be placed after 起.

q: 我们家的客厅很小，要是亲戚都来，肯定坐不___。
zh: 我们家的客厅很小，要是亲戚都来，肯定坐不下。
py: wǒ men jiā de kè tīng hěn xiǎo yào shi qīn qi dōu lái kěn dìng zuò bù xià
en: Our living room is small; if all the relatives come, there definitely won't be room for everyone to sit.
why: Room for people is expressed by 下: 坐不下 'no space to seat them'. 坐不起 and 坐不动 are about money and strength, not space.

s: 弟弟发烧了，这次旅行他去不了了。
s_py: dì di fā shāo le zhè cì lǚ xíng tā qù bù liǎo le
zh: 弟弟发烧了，这次旅行他去不了了。
py: dì di fā shāo le zhè cì lǚ xíng tā qù bù liǎo le
en: My brother has a fever; he can't go on this trip any more.
why: 去不了 (liǎo) is 'cannot go', and the final 了 marks the changed situation. Two different 了 can stand together here.

s: 弟弟看这封信不懂。
s_py: dì di kàn zhè fēng xìn bù dǒng
zh: 弟弟看不懂这封信。
py: dì di kàn bù dǒng zhè fēng xìn
en: My brother can't understand this letter.
why: The object cannot split the verb from its potential block. It comes after 看不懂 or is fronted (这封信弟弟看不懂).

q: 这家手机店很大，你一定找___到。
zh: 这家手机店很大，你一定找得到。
py: zhè jiā shǒu jī diàn hěn dà nǐ yī dìng zhǎo de dào
en: This phone shop is big; you're sure to find it.
why: 一定 expresses certainty that the result will be reached, so the positive 得 fits: 找得到. 不 would say you are sure to fail, against the cue.

q: 明天我要照顾妹妹，我去___你家。
zh: 明天我要照顾妹妹，我去不了你家。
py: míng tiān wǒ yào zhào gù mèi mei wǒ qù bù liǎo nǐ jiā
en: I have to look after my sister tomorrow, so I can't go to your place.
why: No result word is wanted: the action itself cannot happen, so 不了 (liǎo) follows 去. 去不到 / 去不起 / 去不动 give meanings (reach, afford, too weak) the reason does not support.

q: 妈妈说话太小声，我听___见。
zh: 妈妈说话太小声，我听不见。
py: mā ma shuō huà tài xiǎo shēng wǒ tīng bù jiàn
en: Mom speaks too quietly; I can't hear her.
why: 太小声 is the reason the result cannot be reached, so 不 goes between 听 and 见 (听不见). 听得见 would say the opposite, and 没 cannot sit inside a verb-result block.

src: 现在的房子，年轻人买得起。
src_py: xiàn zài de fáng zi nián qīng rén mǎi de qǐ
task: Say young people cannot afford them.
zh: 现在的房子，年轻人买不起。
py: xiàn zài de fáng zi nián qīng rén mǎi bù qǐ
en: Young people can't afford houses these days.
why: 起 means 'afford'; flipping 得 to 不 turns 'can afford' into 'cannot afford'. The object may be fronted as a topic or follow the block.

src_py: zhè jiàn shì wǒ shuō de qīng chu
task: Say you cannot explain this matter clearly.
zh: 这件事我说不清楚。
py: zhè jiàn shì wǒ shuō bù qīng chu
en: I can't explain this matter clearly.
why: Inability to explain is potential 不 right after 说, with nothing before 清楚. 说得不清楚 would only criticise how it was said.

q: 家里没有空调，夏天热得我受___了。
zh: 家里没有空调，夏天热得我受不了。
py: jiā lǐ méi yǒu kōng tiáo xià tiān rè de wǒ shòu bù liǎo
en: There's no air conditioning at home; in summer it's so hot I can't stand it.
why: 受不了 (liǎo) is the set phrase for 'cannot stand'. The heat without air conditioning is the reason, so 不. 受得了 would mean you can bear it.

zh: 哥哥今天回不来了。
py: gē ge jīn tiān huí bù lái le
en: My older brother can't come back today.
why: 不 goes between 回 and the direction 来, and the 了 of the new situation closes the sentence. 不回来 would be a different, refusing meaning.

q: 我感冒得很厉害，明天爸爸的生日聚会我恐怕来___了。
zh: 我感冒得很厉害，明天爸爸的生日聚会我恐怕来不了。
py: wǒ gǎn mào de hěn lì hai míng tiān bà ba de shēng rì jù huì wǒ kǒng pà lái bù liǎo
en: I have a terrible cold; I'm afraid I can't make it to Dad's birthday party tomorrow.
why: A bad cold stops you coming: 来不了 (liǎo). 恐怕 'I'm afraid' goes with a negative outcome, so 来得了 does not fit.

q: 我在房间里说话，你在客厅里听得见___？
zh: 我在房间里说话，你在客厅里听得见听不见？
py: wǒ zài fáng jiān lǐ shuō huà nǐ zài kè tīng lǐ tīng de jiàn tīng bù jiàn
en: I'm talking in my room; can you hear me in the living room or not?
why: The alternative question pairs the full forms: 听得见听不见. Doubling only the complement or adding 吗 and 不 together is not allowed.

src: 我想不起来那家商店的名字。
src_py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái nà jiā shāng diàn de míng zi
task: Add 'any more' with 了.
zh: 我想不起来那家商店的名字了。
py: wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái nà jiā shāng diàn de míng zi le
en: I can't remember the name of that shop any more.
why: Sentence-final 了 closes the sentence after the object; it cannot sit between 起来 and the object.

src: 弟弟听得懂电视里的话。
src_py: dì di tīng de dǒng diàn shì lǐ de huà
task: Ask it the colloquial way: repeat only the verb with 不 (V不V得R).
zh: 弟弟听不听得懂电视里的话？
py: dì di tīng bù tīng de dǒng diàn shì lǐ de huà
en: Can my brother understand what they say on TV?
why: V不V得R: the first verb takes 不 and the second carries 得 + result. 吗 is not added to this question.

zh: 你看不看得懂这张说明书？
py: nǐ kàn bù kàn de dǒng zhè zhāng shuō míng shū
en: Can you understand this instruction sheet?
why: V不V得R: 看不 comes first and the complete 看得懂 follows. The object goes after the whole question block or in front of it.

q: 妈妈要做的菜太多了，一个下午做___完。
zh: 妈妈要做的菜太多了，一个下午做不完。
py: mā ma yào zuò de cài tài duō le yī ge xià wǔ zuò bù wán
en: Mom has too many dishes to cook; she can't finish them in one afternoon.
why: 太多了 is the reason she will fail to finish, so 不 goes between 做 and 完. 得 would claim she can manage it, against the cue.

zh: 妹妹的字写得很好。
py: mèi mei de zì xiě de hěn hǎo
en: My sister's handwriting is very good.
why: Here 得 is the degree complement, and 很 sits between 得 and the adjective. A potential 写不好 would take no 很.

q: 我找___我的钱包。
zh: 我找不到我的钱包。
py: wǒ zhǎo bù dào wǒ de qián bāo
en: I can't find my wallet.
why: 不 goes between 找 and 到, and the object comes after the whole block. 找得不到 and 找不得到 put the pieces in orders that do not exist.

q: 这个手机只要两百块，很便宜，我买___起。
zh: 这个手机只要两百块，很便宜，我买得起。
py: zhè ge shǒu jī zhǐ yào liǎng bǎi kuài hěn pián yi wǒ mǎi de qǐ
en: This phone is only two hundred yuan, very cheap; I can afford it.
why: Cheap means the price is within reach, so the positive 得: 买得起. 买不起 would contradict 只要两百块.

zh: 爸爸明天来不了。
py: bà ba míng tiān lái bù liǎo
en: Dad can't come tomorrow.
why: 不了 (liǎo) after 来 says the action itself cannot happen. Subject and time word come first and 来不了 closes the sentence.

q: 这个沙发太重了，我们两个人也抬___上去。
zh: 这个沙发太重了，我们两个人也抬不上去。
py: zhè ge shā fā tài zhòng le wǒ men liǎng ge rén yě tái bù shàng qù
en: This sofa is so heavy that even the two of us can't carry it up.
why: 太重了 and 也 ('even two people') point to failure, so 不 between 抬 and 上去. 抬得上去 would mean they can; 抬能上去 is not a form.

q: 这件事太复杂了，我说___清楚。
zh: 这件事太复杂了，我说不清楚。
py: zhè jiàn shì tài fù zá le wǒ shuō bù qīng chu
en: This matter is too complicated; I can't explain it clearly.
why: 太复杂了 explains why you are unable, so potential 不 goes directly between 说 and 清楚; 很 never enters a potential form. 说得很清楚 would mean 'explains very clearly'.

q: 离火车开还有两个多小时，我们先回家拿行李，一定来___及。
zh: 离火车开还有两个多小时，我们先回家拿行李，一定来得及。
py: lí huǒ chē kāi hái yǒu liǎng ge duō xiǎo shí wǒ men xiān huí jiā ná xíng li yī dìng lái de jí
en: The train leaves in a little over two hours; we can go home for the luggage first and will surely make it in time.
why: Two hours is plenty of time, and 一定 states certainty, so the positive 来得及. 来不及 would contradict both.

s: 我找了半天，还是没找到我的钱包。
s_py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān hái shi méi zhǎo dào wǒ de qián bāo
zh: 我找了半天，还是没找到我的钱包。
py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān hái shi méi zhǎo dào wǒ de qián bāo
en: I searched for ages and still haven't found my wallet.
why: 没 + verb + result reports that on this occasion the result was not reached. This is correct and not a potential form.

src_py: wǒ zhǎo dào le yào shi
task: Say you cannot find the key (potential form).
zh: 我找不到钥匙。
py: wǒ zhǎo bù dào yào shi
en: I can't find the key.
why: Verb + 不 + result: 不 moves inside the block and 了 is dropped. The object follows the block or is fronted.

src: 爸爸的书房，我们进得去。
src_py: bà ba de shū fáng wǒ men jìn de qù
task: Change it: Dad's rule is that we must not go in.
zh: 爸爸的书房，我们不能进去。
py: bà ba de shū fáng wǒ men bù néng jìn qù
en: We aren't allowed into Dad's study.
why: A rule or ban is 不能 + verb, with 进去 whole after it. 进不去 would mean a physical obstacle such as a locked door.

q: 这么多作业，你今天做得完做___完？
zh: 这么多作业，你今天做得完做不完？
py: zhè me duō zuò yè nǐ jīn tiān zuò de wán zuò bù wán
en: With this much homework, can you finish it today or not?
why: The full pair repeats the whole potential: 做得完做不完. The negative half is 不 between verb and result; 没 and 不得 do not make a potential.

src_py: zhè zuò shān yé ye pá de shàng qù
task: Say Grandpa cannot climb up it.
zh: 这座山爷爷爬不上去。
py: zhè zuò shān yé ye pá bù shàng qù
en: Grandpa can't climb up this mountain.
why: 得 becomes 不 in the same slot. The two-part direction 上去 stays whole, so the object 这座山 is fronted as a topic.

s: 弟弟唱歌唱不很好，大家都爱听。
s_py: dì di chàng gē chàng bù hěn hǎo dà jiā dōu ài tīng
zh: 弟弟唱歌唱得很好，大家都爱听。
py: dì di chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo dà jiā dōu ài tīng
en: My brother sings very well and everyone likes to listen.
why: To say how well he sings, use the degree complement 唱得很好. A potential 不 never takes 很, so 唱不很好 is not a form.

s: 冰箱太小了，放不下这么多水果。
s_py: bīng xiāng tài xiǎo le fàng bù xià zhè me duō shuǐ guǒ
zh: 冰箱太小了，放不下这么多水果。
py: bīng xiāng tài xiǎo le fàng bù xià zhè me duō shuǐ guǒ
en: The fridge is too small to hold this much fruit.
why: 下 means enough room, so 放不下 + object after the block is correct. 不能放 would be a ban.

src_py: míng tiān wǒ qù nǐ jiā
task: Say you cannot go to their house tomorrow (use 不了).
zh: 明天我去不了你家。
py: míng tiān wǒ qù bù liǎo nǐ jiā
en: I can't go to your place tomorrow.
why: No result word fits, so 不了 (liǎo) follows the verb: the action itself cannot happen. 不去了 would mean having decided not to go.

s: 门上贴着通知，没有老师同意，学生不能进去。
s_py: mén shàng tiē zhe tōng zhī méi yǒu lǎo shī tóng yì xué sheng bù néng jìn qù
zh: 门上贴着通知，没有老师同意，学生不能进去。
py: mén shàng tiē zhe tōng zhī méi yǒu lǎo shī tóng yì xué sheng bù néng jìn qù
en: A notice on the door says students can't go in without the teacher's consent.
why: A notice is a rule, so 不能 + 进去 is right. 进不去 would only say they are physically unable to get in.

src_py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ shuì zháo le
task: Say you could not fall asleep last night (potential, no 了).
zh: 昨天晚上我睡不着。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ shuì bù zháo
en: I couldn't fall asleep last night.
why: 睡不着 is the set potential for failing to fall asleep and takes no 了 even for a past night.

q: 医生说爸爸刚做完手术，现在还___下床。
zh: 医生说爸爸刚做完手术，现在还不能下床。
py: yī shēng shuō bà ba gāng zuò wán shǒu shù xiàn zài hái bù néng xià chuáng
en: The doctor says Dad has just had an operation and must not get out of bed yet.
why: A doctor's instruction is 'not allowed': 不能 + verb. 不了 and 不到 are potential endings and cannot stand in front of 下床.

q: 我肚子已经很饱了，再好吃的蛋糕也吃不___了。
zh: 我肚子已经很饱了，再好吃的蛋糕也吃不下了。
py: wǒ dù zi yǐ jīng hěn bǎo le zài hǎo chī de dàn gāo yě chī bù xià le
en: I'm already full; I can't eat any more, even the tastiest cake.
why: A full stomach means no room, which is 下: 吃不下. 吃不完 is about too much food to finish, not about being full.

s: 这么贵的手机，我不买起。
s_py: zhè me guì de shǒu jī wǒ bù mǎi qǐ
zh: 这么贵的手机，我买不起。
py: zhè me guì de shǒu jī wǒ mǎi bù qǐ
en: I can't afford such an expensive phone.
why: 'Cannot afford' is 买不起 with 不 inside the block. 不买起 puts 不 before the verb, which is not a form.

q: 外面太吵了，我怎么也睡___好。
zh: 外面太吵了，我怎么也睡不好。
py: wài miàn tài chǎo le wǒ zěn me yě shuì bù hǎo
en: It's too noisy outside; I can't sleep well no matter what.
why: 太吵了 and 怎么也 mean 'unable', so the potential 睡不好. 睡得好 and 睡得很好 describe how well you sleep and do not fit 'can't no matter what'.

src: 这张沙发我们搬得进去。
src_py: zhè zhāng shā fā wǒ men bān de jìn qù
task: Say we cannot carry it in.
zh: 这张沙发我们搬不进去。
py: zhè zhāng shā fā wǒ men bān bù jìn qù
en: We can't get this sofa in.
why: 不 replaces 得 right after the verb, before the direction word. 进去 stays whole, so the object is fronted.

q: 妈妈说了，晚上十点以后你们___玩，必须在家睡觉。
zh: 妈妈说了，晚上十点以后你们不能出去玩，必须在家睡觉。
py: mā ma shuō le wǎn shang shí diǎn yǐ hòu nǐ men bù néng chū qù wán bì xū zài jiā shuì jiào
en: Mom said you must not go out to play after ten at night; you have to be at home asleep.
why: A parent's rule means 'not allowed': 不能 + verb. 出不去 would say you are physically unable to get out, and no obstacle is mentioned.

q: 这种牛奶已经卖完了，我跑了三家超市也买不___。
zh: 这种牛奶已经卖完了，我跑了三家超市也买不到。
py: zhè zhǒng niú nǎi yǐ jīng mài wán le wǒ pǎo le sān jiā chāo shì yě mǎi bù dào
en: This kind of milk is sold out; I went to three supermarkets and still couldn't get any.
why: Sold out means you cannot get hold of it: 买不到. 买不起 is about price, and 买不下 and 买不动 are about room and strength.

src_py: wǒ chī de xià zhè ge dà dàn gāo
task: Say you are full and cannot eat any more of it (end with 了).
zh: 我吃不下这个大蛋糕了。
py: wǒ chī bù xià zhè ge dà dàn gāo le
en: I can't eat any more of this big cake.
why: 下 means room left, and 不 says none is left. 了 marks the change 'not any more' at the very end, after the object.

q: 昨天太忙了，我___看到那条短信。
zh: 昨天太忙了，我没看到那条短信。
py: zuó tiān tài máng le wǒ méi kàn dào nà tiáo duǎn xìn
en: I was too busy yesterday and didn't see that text message.
why: One occasion in the past: 没 + verb + result. 不 + 看到 does not report a past event, and 能 would say what was possible, not what happened.

src: 我今天做完了所有的作业。
src_py: wǒ jīn tiān zuò wán le suǒ yǒu de zuò yè
task: Say you cannot finish all of it today (potential form).
zh: 我今天做不完所有的作业。
py: wǒ jīn tiān zuò bù wán suǒ yǒu de zuò yè
en: I can't finish all the homework today.
why: Cannot manage = verb + 不 + result, with the object after the whole block (or fronted). 没做完 would only say it did not get finished.

s: 奶奶感冒了，周末她来不我们家。
s_py: nǎi nai gǎn mào le zhōu mò tā lái bù wǒ men jiā
zh: 奶奶感冒了，周末她来不了我们家。
py: nǎi nai gǎn mào le zhōu mò tā lái bù liǎo wǒ men jiā
en: Grandma has a cold; she can't come to our house at the weekend.
why: With no result word the complement is 了 (liǎo): 来不了. Bare 不 cannot be followed straight by the object.

zh: 我听不懂售货员的话。
py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng shòu huò yuán de huà
en: I can't understand what the shop assistant says.
why: 不 sits inside the block 听不懂; the object follows the whole block or is fronted as a topic. It cannot go between 听 and 懂.

src_py: wǒ men lái de jí chī zǎo fàn
task: Say there is no time for it.
zh: 我们来不及吃早饭。
